text: {"reply": "Thanks for your patience, and I'm sorry you've had to write more than once. I need to correct my colleague's last message: I can't approve a refund or confirm its timing. Only the service manager can decide that. I'm passing RO-168471 to a person now with your note that you declined the brake fluid flush and have the text. They will review the charge and contact you. To help them find your file, could you tell me the last name on the account?", "action": "escalated", "escalation_reason": "policy_limit", "summary": "Customer disputes a $1,427 CAD charge on RO-168471 for a brake fluid flush on a 2023 Meridian Lumen EV, saying they declined the service when called by Gregory and have a text as proof. They want a refund to the original card, not a credit, and say earlier tickets were closed without reply. A colleague wrongly told them a refund would take 3–5 business days once approved; I corrected that and did not confirm any refund. Customer not yet verified (no last name given), so no invoice was pulled. Needs service manager review, and the customer should be asked for the text and last name.", "policy_rules_cited": ["P-03", "P-04", "P-08", "P-10"]}
